themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, analyze data, and generate insights.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools and techniques for condensing large amounts of text, such as research findings or meeting transcripts, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles about AI tools that help developers write, review, and debug code, including specific research on their security and efficacy.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Discusses specific AI-powered tools designed to aid researchers in various stages of their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI research platforms
themes.description: Covers dedicated platforms or environments designed to facilitate AI-driven research, offering integrated tools and capabilities.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that compare, review, or assess the performance and usability of various AI tools for UX and research.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is changing job roles, hiring practices, and the skills required for the future workforce in design and research.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is applied to the design process itself, including generative design, AI-assisted prototyping, and design system integration.

themes.name: AI sentiment & feedback analysis
themes.description: Covers the use of AI to analyze user feedback, reviews, and sentiment to derive actionable insights.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Discusses AI's role in automating testing processes, particularly in software development and UI/UX quality assurance.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
